Nebius Reportedly Plans 20% GPU Price Increase
Nebius reportedly plans to raise GPU cloud prices by roughly 20% starting Oct. 1 across several NVIDIA GPU models, including the H100, H200, B200 and B300.
The H100 rate is expected to increase to $4.50 from $3.85, while the H200 rate could rise to $5.40 from $4.50.
The proposed increases point to continued demand for high-end AI computing capacity and Nebius’ ability to charge more for GPU cloud services.

Nebius remains above all its major moving averages, including the 20-day SMA of $220.95, 50-day SMA of $214.22, 100-day SMA of $219.56 and 200-day SMA of $163.41.
